description: Defines the class uci_allocator_impl implementing the uci_allocator interface for UCI scheduling in a wireless communication system, including methods for slot indication, resource allocation, and UCI management.

classes.name: uci_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the uci_allocator interface for UCI scheduling, managing UCI allocations, and resource scheduling.

methods.name: uci_allocator_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UCI allocator with cell configuration and PUCCH allocator.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication events for scheduling.

methods.name: alloc_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates HARQ acknowledgment resources for a given UE.

methods.name: get_scheduled_pdsch_counter_in_ue_uci
methods.description: Retrieves the count of scheduled PDSCH in a UCI.

methods.name: has_harq_ack_on_common_pucch_res
methods.description: Checks for HARQ ACK on common PUCCH resources.

methods.name: get_uci_alloc
methods.description: Fetches UCI allocation info for a slot and RNTI.

methods.name: get_min_pdsch_to_ack_slot_distance
methods.description: Calculates minimum slot distance between PDSCH and UCI HARQ ACK.
